title: dpsc-wls-human-scRNAseq: WLS (GPR177/Wntless) expression in candidate human dental pulp stem cells
description:
Reproducible R pipeline for a donor-aware single-cell RNA-seq analysis of WLS (GPR177/Wntless), the cargo receptor required for secretion of Wnt ligands, in human dental pulp.

Data. Public dataset GEO GSE164157 (human dental pulp, five donors, 10x Genomics). Raw and processed data are not redistributed; they are downloaded from GEO by the pipeline.

Workflow. Quality control (Seurat v5); doublet removal (scDblFinder); donor integration (Harmony); marker-based cell type annotation; identification of candidate dental pulp stem cells (DPSCs) from a stem/progenitor score kept separate from perivascular markers; WLS quantification per donor; donor-paired pseudobulk edgeR quasi-likelihood tests; mixed-effects logistic models (lme4); depth-adjusted WLS/WNT co-expression; and sensitivity analysis across four DPSC definitions. Package versions are locked with renv.

Contents. Analysis scripts (scripts/), locked R environment (renv.lock), cluster annotations (data/annotation/), figures and tables for each stage (results/), and documentation (docs/).

Licensing. Code is released under the MIT licence (LICENSE). Reports, figures and tables are released under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-docs.md).
notes: Analysis performed in the laboratory of Professor Wei Hsu, The ADA Forsyth Institute. Please also cite the original publication associated with GEO GSE164157.
